title: Au-modified ZnO thin films for higher-performance ultraviolet photodetectors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49728-49738
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08186F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Akshta Rajan, Kashima Arora, Bhavna Vidhani, Jasvir Dalal, Pawan Kumar
Au-overlayer ZnO UV photodetectors achieve nanoampere dark current and show gain (K = 7.79 × 103) at 24 µW/cm² via Schottky barrier control, Au2O3 defect engineering, and plasmon-enhanced absorption, enabling lower-intensity, scalable UV sensing.
